column3: hiraṇyaṃ hāṭakaṃ rukmaṃ suvarṇaṃ hema kāñcanam |
svarṇaṃ kārtasvaraṃ bharma gāṅgeyaṃ kanakaṃ vasu |
suvarṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ kaṣāyaṃ lekhanaṃ himam |
śuddhaṃ kupyaṃ vasuśreṣṭhaṃ vimalaṃ śvetakaṃ śivam |
tāmraṃ tiktaṃ himaṃ svādu kaṣāyāmlaṃ saraṃ laghu ||
kāṃsyaṃ lohanibhaṃ ghoṣaṃ prakāśaṃ kamalaṃ lavam |
kāṃsyaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tiktoṣṇaṃ lekhanaṃ viśadaṃ saram ||

column3: rūkṣaṃ guru kaphaṃ pittaṃ hanti dṛṣṭiprasādanam |
raṅgaṃ vaṅgaṃ rūpaśaṃkhaṃ nighaṭaṃ piccaṭaṃ sitam |
śītaṃ trapukam ānīlaṃ kharaṭī nīlikā ghanam ||
trapukaṃ tiktakaṃ bhedi laghūṣṇaṃ lekhanaṃ paṭu ||
mehaghnaṃ pittalaṃ kiṃcit tadvad vidyād bhujaṃgakam ||
ayaḥ kālāyasaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ piṇḍaṃ pāravasaṃ ghanam |
lohaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ghanalohaṃ vīraṃ cīmaram āyasam ||
siṃhānaṃ lohaviṣṭhā tu maṇḍūraṃ syād ayomalaḥ ||
lohaṃ tiktaṃ saraṃ śītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ guru ||
rūkṣaṃ vayasyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ lekhanaṃ vātalaṃ jayet |
column5: rūkṣaṃ vayasyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ lekhanaṃ vātalaṃ jayet ||
column9: rūkṣaṃ vayasyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ lekhanaṃ vātalaṃ jayet ||

column3: abhrakaṃ madhuraṃ śītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ guru dhātukṛt ||
vyavāyī kaṭukaḥ pāke svaryo vṛṣyo rasāyanaḥ |
mākṣiko dvividhaḥ proktaḥ pītaḥ śuklastathaiva ca ||
kiṃcit kaṣāya ubhayaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ ||
kucailā kunaṭī golā nepālā kavarī kalā |
haritālaṃ kaṣāyoṣṇaṃ kaṭu snigdhaṃ hared viṣam ||
tutthakaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāraṃ kaṣāyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu |
column5: tutthakaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāraṃ kaṣāyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu |
column9: tutthakaṃ kaṭu sakṣāraṃ kaṣāyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu |

column3: srotojaṃ yāmunaṃ nadyaṃ nadījaṃ nandanaṃ varam ||
sauvīraṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ kaṣāyaṃ lekhanaṃ himam ||
cakṣuṣyaṃ pravaraṃ grāhi tadvat srotoñjanaṃ matam ||
bolaṃ jātīrasaṃ pauraṃ nirlohaṃ barbaraṃ rasam ||
rasagandhaṃ ca gandhāmnaṃ gomataṃ nālikaṃ balam |
bolastiktaḥ kaṭuḥ svāduḥ pācano dīpano himaḥ |
maṅgalyā gautamī gaurī bhogyā rucyā ca pācanī |
medhyā gopittajā vaśyā piṅgalā rocanā smṛtā ||
śaileyaṃ sthaviraṃ vṛddhaṃ śailajaṃ palitaṃ gṛham |
tiktoṣṇaṃ śukralaṃ varṇyaṃ hṛdyaṃ hanti kaphānilau ||

column5: saindhavaṃ rucakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ viḍaṃ sāmudram audbhidam |

column3: lavaṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ pācanaṃ rocanaṃ mṛdu ||
saindhavaṃ sindhu sindhūtthaṃ nādeyaṃ vimalaṃ varam |
śivaṃ śītaśivaṃ śuddhaṃ sindhujaṃ lavaṇaṃ param ||
saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ svādu dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ laghu ||
column5: saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ svādu dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ laghu |

column5: snigdhaṃ rucyaṃ himaṃ vṛṣyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ netryaṃ tridoṣahṛt ||

column3: saugandhikaṃ ca jaraṇam akṣam anyad agandhikam |
rucakaṃ rocanaṃ hṛdyaṃ dīpanaṃ viśadaṃ laghu ||
kṛṣṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ mecakaṃ tilakaṃ tathā |
dīpanaṃ laghu tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ rucyaṃ vyavāyi ca ||
column5: dīpanaṃ laghu tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ rucyaṃ vyavāyi ca |

column3: sāmudraṃ madhuraṃ pāke satiktaṃ kaṭukaṃ guru ||
column5: sāmudraṃ madhuraṃ pāke satiktaṃ madhuraṃ guru |
nātyuṣṇaṃ dīpanaṃ bhedi sakṣāram avidāhi ca |

column3: vātaghnaṃ tīkṣṇamatyuṣṇaṃ bhedi sūkṣmaṃ vyavāyi ca ||
ūṣakakṣāram aurvaṃ syād auṣaṃ sarvaguṇaṃ tathā ||
pāṃśukaṃ kaṭukaṃ snigdhaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru |
kācaṃ pākyaṃ trikūṭaṃ syātsarvaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ kaṭu ||
abdhipheno laghuḥ śītaḥ kaṣāyo lekhano jayet ||
śaṃkho.nuṣṇaḥ kaṭuḥ pāke kaṣāyo madhuro laghuḥ ||

column5: cakṣuṣyā lekhanāḥ śītāḥ kaṣāyā madhurāḥ sarāḥ |
